description: arithmetic mean of per-residue pLDDT over the structure context residues of the selected fragment
missing_when: the structure is absent, no residue of the window maps into the model, or every window residue lacks the required atoms

description: fraction of structure context residues assigned the generic helix state
missing_when: the structure is absent, no residue of the window maps into the model, or every window residue lacks the required atoms

description: fraction of structure context residues assigned the strand state
missing_when: the structure is absent, no residue of the window maps into the model, or every window residue lacks the required atoms

description: residue SASA divided by the theoretical maximum ASA for that residue type
missing_when: the structure is absent, no residue of the window maps into the model, every window residue lacks the required atoms, or none remain once chain-terminal residues are excluded
source: FreeSASA residue SASA, normalised by the Tien et al. 2013 maximum ASA table

description: mean over structure context residues of the sum of inverse-square CA-CA distances to all other resolvable residues in the selected fragment
missing_when: the structure is absent, no residue of the window maps into the model, or every window residue lacks the required atoms
source: Yeh et al. 2014 Mol Biol Evol site-specific packing density

description: mean over structure context residues of the number of other residues whose CA lies within 8.0 A
missing_when: the structure is absent, no residue of the window maps into the model, or every window residue lacks the required atoms
source: contact-number convention, contact cutoff 8.0 A between CA atoms

description: count of structure context residues that contact at least one residue in each complete five-residue flank
missing_when: either flank is incomplete, the structure is absent, no residue of the window maps into the model, or every window residue lacks the required atoms
source: Vendruscolo et al. 2002 key-residue contact analysis

description: 1 when a single contiguous helix or strand element strictly contains the whole window on both sides
missing_when: the structure is absent, no residue of the window maps into the model, or every window residue lacks the required atoms

description: fraction of the single containing element covered by the window; a window measured entirely in loop gives 0
missing_when: the structure is absent, or the window spans more than one distinct C3 element

description: mean over structure context residues of the number of backbone hydrogen bonds in which the residue participates as donor or acceptor
missing_when: the structure is absent, no residue of the window maps into the model, or every window residue lacks the required atoms

description: fraction of structure context residues that are both buried by true RSA and hydrophobic
missing_when: no window residue has a resolvable RSA, the structure is absent, no residue of the window maps into the model, or every window residue lacks the required atoms

description: mean track score over the deleted reference bases for deletions, and over the twelve CDS bases of the four junction residues for insertions
missing_when: the track lookup fails, no base maps, or the four-residue insertion context is incomplete

description: mean track score over the deleted reference bases for deletions, and over the twelve CDS bases of the four junction residues for insertions
missing_when: the track lookup fails, no base maps, or the four-residue insertion context is incomplete

description: amino-acid length change computed from the normalised allele
missing_when: never

description: indel_size_aa divided by the MANE Select translated protein length
missing_when: the MANE protein length is unresolved

description: deletion or insertion, recomputed from the normalised allele and cross-checked against the VEP consequence
missing_when: never

description: Shannon entropy in bits over the 20 standard residues in the span-dependent window
missing_when: the canonical sequence is unavailable or fewer than three residues are counted

description: change in mean Kyte-Doolittle hydropathy of the local sequence caused by the variant, mutant minus wild type
missing_when: the MANE Select CDS translation cannot be produced, the mutant protein cannot be reconstructed, the reconstruction disagrees with the VEP HGVSp cross-check, or either local sequence contains a residue outside the 20 standard amino acids
source: Kyte and Doolittle, J Mol Biol 1982;157:105-132

description: change in the Shannon entropy of the local amino-acid composition caused by the variant, mutant minus wild type
missing_when: the MANE Select CDS translation cannot be produced, the mutant protein cannot be reconstructed, the reconstruction disagrees with the VEP HGVSp cross-check, or either local sequence contains a residue outside the 20 standard amino acids

description: change in the mean Klein et al. 1984 net charge of the local sequence caused by the variant, mutant minus wild type
missing_when: the MANE Select CDS translation cannot be produced, the mutant protein cannot be reconstructed, the reconstruction disagrees with the VEP HGVSp cross-check, or either local sequence contains a residue outside the 20 standard amino acids
source: Klein, Kanehisa and DeLisi, Biochim Biophys Acta 1984;787:221-226
